top_signals.title: Congress Could Have Prevented Megaspeed Access: McGuire
top_signals.summary: Chris McGuire, a senior fellow for China and emerging technologies at the Council on Foreign Relations and former Biden administration technology and national security official, says the key question is not whether export controls can work, but whether they are being enforced. McGuire speaks with Romaine Bostick and Jess Menton on “The Close.” (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Wild Price Swings Expose Stress in Hong Kong Stocks, Study Shows
